fields.statement: At 3ebbaa2d, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/run-abandon-unpushed.txtar sits beside run-abandon-unmerged.txtar. It runs a build that commits on cs/abandon-built, pushes it with -u to a bare origin.git, runs a second build whose commit is never pushed, fails a third run, abandons it, and asserts stdout 'delete-branch kept: it has commits merged into neither its upstream nor HEAD', that git log cs/abandon-built still shows both 'built' commits, and that origin/cs/abandon-built..cs/abandon-built counts 1. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-abandon-(unpushed|unmerged)$' -count=1 -v: both PASS. The message comes from internal/api/run.go's git branch -d guard, which refuses a branch not merged into its upstream or HEAD.
